Name: Plantopia Farm
Author: Kreeate777
Description:
[b][color=#1e84cc][u][b][u]UPDATE 2.1.1 for MAIN Version only:[/u][/b][/u][/color][color=#ff0000][u][b][color=#ff0000][u]
[/u][/color][/b][/u][/color][/b][list]
[*]Changed the exit coordinates from Farm to Bus Stop to address a potential bug.
[/list][b][color=#ff0000][u]
UPDATE 2.1.0 for MAIN Version only:[/u][u]
[/u][/color][/b][list]
[*]The farmhouse has been moved down a bit, but you can later move it anywhere you like.
[*]Pet bowl position has been fixed.
[*]Terrain under house after moving it, fixed.
[*]Spouse area fixed.
[*]Intro Scene misalignment fixed.
[*]Standard starting furniture (TV) is now fixed on new farms.
[*]Duplicate Mailbox issue fixed.
[*]The Greenhouse, Main house, Shipping Bin and Pet Bowl can now be moved wherever you like. Ask Robin.
[*][b]Please feel free to leave feedback and comments.  I will do my best to accommodate requests.[/b]
[/list][i][b][u][size=3]Installation[/size][/u][/b]
[/i][list=1]
[*][i]Download, then extract the zipped file to your mods folder (choose "extract here" to avoid double folders)[/i]
[*][i]Download and install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/i]
[*][i]Start your game and choose to start a new farm.[/i]
[*][i]At farm selection, choose the Plantopia Farm icon. Click it and then set up your character etc.[/i]
[*][i]All done![/i]
[/list] ﻿
[b][u][size=3]Basic Information[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]A relatively large and simple green farm ( 150 x 65 ) with ample space for your ideal layout.
[*] Space for large fields of golden wheat, barley or corn. Your imagination is the limit.
[*][color=#00ff00][b]All grass is tillable[/b].[/color]
[*]Has a small northern river with space for at least 55 crab pots.
[*]The farm is surrounded by lush seasonal forest.
[*]All warp points function as intended and there are no strange "[i]warping into the middle of the farm[/i]" issues.
[/list]
[b][u][size=3]Requirements and compatibility[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]This Farm map requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]This Farm map is compatible with any re-color mods.
[/list]
[i][size=2]To uninstall this map, simply delete [color=#8e7cc3]PlantopiaFarm[/color] from your Mods folder.[/size][/i]

Downloads.Description: Version 2.1.1 fixes a potential bug when moving from Farm to Bus Stop.
